note: ESPN's odds feed gives archived closing/final pregame lines with no per-quote observed_at: a closing-line benchmark, not decision-time quotes. The line is E's pinned rule (median across non-live providers, fixed before any outcome was joined; sha256 in the header); nothing was fitted on any line. Fit-window games (on or before the frozen validation end) were used to fit v6's calibration and v5's, so the holdout-window seasons are the clean test, and from 2024 on each event carries a single book (ESPN BET 2024-25, DraftKings 2025-26), so the median is that book's close. Against the 575 reference the pinned spreads had 13 sign flips of 576 (inferred to be reference-side line-pair repeats, not verified). The 575/576 check is a design-informed subset of the 2026 holdout-window season and is not independent of it. Spread of projections, over% by line bucket and dog takes are diagnostics, not evidence. No promotion decision.
